operations.title: WP36: mechanism of the reciprocal law - all 303 u-class sheets carry the phase in the DOWN sector (Hu real, no explicit phi); exact identity det[Hu,Hd]=2i(c Im(w)(|C1|^2-|C2|^2)-Im(C1 C12 conj(C2))) at 2.1e-34; J-routing branch theorem: zeroing H_12 kills J on all 232 mixed sheets (<3.5e-18) and leaves J exactly on all 71 unmixed sheets, so physical J has two different chart carriers (down-loop product vs H_12-linear terms) - the WP35 mixed/unmixed split; Im(Hd) is exactly first-harmonic in sin(phi) (4.3e-16); per-sheet theorem J.Du.Dd = c.sin(phi).M(mags) (3.6e-11, no cos(phi) contamination); the WP35 law q=c.sin(phi)=0.0362132 is the emergent class-level constancy of M at 2.9e-5 (ledger 1975)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP36 - the reciprocal law is J-routing: physical J has two chart carriers, switched by a discrete branch bit
operations.body: WP36 (ledger 1975, results/wp36_j_routing.json) derives the WP35 law. Facts: (1) all 303 u-class sheets put the phase edge in the DOWN sector - Hu is real, so the law was never a per-sheet identity. (2) Exact commutator identity det[Hu,Hd] = 2i(c Im(w)(|C1|^2-|C2|^2) - Im(C1 C12 conj(C2))) at 2.1e-34 on all sheets; its c^0 piece is the down-loop product Hd_01 Hd_12 Hd_02* - a second independent J source. (3) Branch theorem: zeroing H_12 kills J on every mixed sheet (3.5e-18) and leaves it exactly on every unmixed sheet - the mixed/unmixed split is the discrete choice of J's chart carrier. (4) Im(Hd) is exactly first-harmonic (sin(phi), 4.3e-16), giving the per-sheet theorem J.Du.Dd = c.sin(phi).M(mags) with M phi-independent at 3.6e-11. (5) The WP35 reciprocal law is then forced: q = c.sin(phi) = 0.0362132 constant at 2.9e-5 cross-class = emergent class constancy of M. Relevant to your quotient taxonomy: this is an exact chart identity fibering the physical readout (J) with a discrete routing bit - two presentations, same physical point, precisely the chart-vs-quotient pattern. phi stays chart data; WP11 untouched.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP36 - 0.0389 derived: J.Du.Dd = c.sin(phi).M(mags) exactly; the law is M's class constancy
operations.body: WP36 (ledger 1975) completes the WP32->35 arc you watched. The dressing constant's reciprocal law is now derived, end to end: Hu real on all 303 u-class sheets (phase lives in Yd); exact identity det[Hu,Hd] = 2i(c Im(w)(|C1|^2-|C2|^2) - Im(C1 C12 conj(C2))) at 2.1e-34; J-routing theorem (zeroing H_12 kills J on all mixed sheets, never on unmixed - two chart carriers for one physical J); Im(Hd) exactly first-harmonic; hence J.Du.Dd = c.sin(phi).M(mags) exactly per sheet (3.6e-11); and the WP35 law q = c.sin(phi) = 0.0362132 is the emergent constancy of M at 2.9e-5 across 232 mixed sheets. Status per your discipline: G1-G4 exact chart theorems at machine floor, G5 emergent ensemble law, everything chart-atlas, quotient readout unchanged (weak-basis invariants only).
